independent_coverage_check.exclusion_ruling: Reviewed all 61 reasoned exclusions against the raw source. They cover the ambient construction, B7 numerical proof, TV comparison, Eq25 and product/amplification steps without removing a necessary source density or initial-affinity clause. Six additional heading/container exclusions do not conceal substantive text.

binder_challenge.boundary_cases: The public domain includes n=3, odd n and kappa=4. It introduces no d, k, T, parity, matrix-SPD, probability, measurable-kernel, Fubini, L1 or mass premise.
binder_challenge.source_basis: A2.SS2.p2.1 gives the independent single-block standing domain. The source ambient n<=d context in Section3.1 does not become a single-block density requirement.

definition_challenge.name: orthogonalHaar
definition_challenge.ruling: Canonical normalized Haar on full O(n), both signs, as assigned by the seal. Its construction/characterization implementation was not re-audited.

definition_challenge.name: nu_pos,nu_neg
definition_challenge.ruling: Exactly 2 times restriction of that same full Haar to det=+1 and det=-1. This is the source conditional probability since each event has mass 1/2. No replacement SO(n)-only base or unnormalized prior is permitted.

definition_challenge.name: singleBlockPrecision
definition_challenge.ruling: Sealed meaning is literal Eq4. SPD/inverse-covariance validity stays an internal consequence/provider; no hSPD binder is licensed.

definition_challenge.name: gamma
definition_challenge.ruling: The actual Mathlib multivariateGaussian with mean zero and covariance A_O inverse is fixed, rather than a placeholder family of laws. Assigned Gaussian density correspondence must later certify the coordinate/base-measure agreement.

definition_challenge.name: p
definition_challenge.ruling: sqrt(det A_O)/(2*pi)^((n:Real)/2) times exp(-(x dot A_O*x)/2) has the correct precision normalization, real half dimension including odd n, and Euclidean Lebesgue convention. The full formula is a standard expansion implicit in the source Gaussian-density convention, not a separately printed author theorem.

definition_challenge.name: q_pos,q_neg
definition_challenge.ruling: These are literal pointwise real Bochner averages of that fixed p under the actual conditioned priors. They choose density representatives; they are not pointwise identities with every possible source p_b.

definition_challenge.name: volume.withDensity(ofReal q)
definition_challenge.ruling: Both actual bind mixtures must equal this actual measure. Pointwise nonnegativity prevents ofReal truncation from disguising negative values; measurable q, genuine outer L1 and real mass one are separate required conclusions.

A formula for a chosen product representative, not a pointwise identity valid for all arbitrary independently modified versions. Under arbitrary density-version changes it is interpreted a.e.; finite products of Lebesgue densities define the same product law.

every_p_b_use_audit.ae_ruling: Finite-dimensional product Lebesgue measures are sigma-finite; null exceptional cylinders and their finite union are null. Product/sqrt/min integrands and all displayed integrals are unchanged. Product and amplification results remain excluded.

representative_and_ae_challenge.canonical_p_O_caveat: The paper also makes pointwise covariance/radialization and envelope statements about p_O in B.2.2. Such pointwise statements are not invariant under arbitrary exceptional-set modifications of p_O. The seal fixes the standard continuous Gaussian formula, so it does not rely on that false blanket invariance. Ex56 inner x-integrals themselves are density-version invariant when the ordinary integrability conditions hold.
representative_and_ae_challenge.forbidden_upgrade: Do not promote any a.e. p_b equality to equality at every x; do not claim arbitrary p_O versions obey the source pointwise identities.

inner_outer_L1_and_actual_law_challenge.pointwise_inner_L1: bridge:pointwise-inner-L1 explicitly requires Integrable (fun O => p O x) for every x under each actual conditioned prior. Joint measurability and finite-prior domination are internal; source spectral/envelope context is sufficient semantic motivation but is not an already checked new proof.
inner_outer_L1_and_actual_law_challenge.outer_L1_and_masses: bridge:mixture-L1-mass requires genuine Lebesgue L1, nonnegativity and real integral one, justified by actual component normalization and actual probability priors. A totalized real integral identity alone is insufficient.
inner_outer_L1_and_actual_law_challenge.actual_bind_density_identity: bridge:selected-representative requires both nu_b.bind gamma = volume.withDensity(ofReal q_b), with all kernel/integration interchange side conditions discharged internally.
inner_outer_L1_and_actual_law_challenge.non_atomic_analytic_inputs: The active-edge phrase actual component-density masses is an internal analytic consequence of the assigned Gaussian law-density identity plus the actual Gaussian probability/finite-density facts. It is not an extra fourth assigned opaque provider and cannot become a public premise. Likewise actual twice-restricted probability priors is the displayed output from the component-probabilities atom and the literal conditioned-prior definition.

focused_consumer_challenge.actual_object: a = integral x, sqrt(q_pos(x)*q_neg(x)), for the actual selected densities produced by the sealed packet.
focused_consumer_challenge.source_support: Ex68 and the immediately following source Cauchy-Schwarz/unit-mass sentence.
focused_consumer_challenge.dependency_ruling: The actual density outputs, square-root measurability/L2 facts and Cauchy-Schwarz suffice. The graph requires these internal expansions and does not accept a generic disconnected affinity calculation as the focused consumer.
